subject: C14
required_fixes: R1: crates/desktop-core/src/authority/workbench_domain.rs:1810 and the save() Ok(None) branch retain an obsolete protected draft when the submitted fields equal the saved baseline. Reproduction: open saved snapshot A, edit to B and allow Protect to complete, revert to A, then Save before the protection debounce. save() neither replaces nor removes draft B, persists it, returns Unchanged with B in document.fields, and clears the editing guard. The React handler cancels the pending debounce and acknowledges this Save, so quitting and reopening can recover B despite the successful save of A. Reconcile and durably persist draft/recovered state for unchanged saves before acknowledging them. Add a production-interface regression covering Protect(B), Save(A), restart and reopen, asserting fields A, no obsolete draft and unchanged project bytes; add a React regression for reverting and saving before debounce.
optional_suggestions: crates/desktop-core/src/workbench/project.rs:369 collects and sorts the entire directory before enforcing MAX_ENTRIES. Bound enumeration before collection so a very large directory cannot defeat the advertised discovery resource limit; handle directory-entry errors explicitly rather than dropping them.
